subject: I'll Be Back...
author: ZombieTron
body:
on Revenge a bit more often I think, as it is still the most fun game to play on Xbox Live! 🙂

I'm feeling pretty isolated by the snow too, although I did go for a mini walk with baby girl today, it was literally just around our apartment complex! Nice to feel the crunch of the snow beneath my feet and luckily the all-terrain buggy we have coped very well in the conditions!

We have been drifting a lot in real life due to the snow which is a bit scary! I am glad Xandu is a good driver!

I hope Split/Second improves from the E3 build, as there is still no firm date for release I guess they are still working on it.

Love you back Suf! and I'm looking forward to hearing your song!! 🎵

subject: Gutted I missed...
author: ichienkai
body:
you chaps and chapppess's on Revenge t'other evening, but there may be more over the next few days as we all have time off or are completely stranded, like me, because of the snow.  Good mini blog and great examples of the better places where you would get some of your driftgasms, especially Angel Valley, exactly how you described it Suf and the Mountains of course where its possible to suprise yourself with the smoothness of your drifts going through the lefty/righty twisties. 

Favourite track of mine is Lone Peak F and there is the jump at the startish of the race off the wooden bridge (most people go through the centre but dont always on Reverse)? And then the quick drift right into the little trailer park - a bit treacherous for some in there - but a beauty when done correctly.  Could race a hundred races and get it right every time only to have one 3 lap race and crash in there every lap lol

The other goodie jump into drift is the Motor City LF wooden ramp on the left - 3/4 way into the lap, just after right drift into small tunnel - you can hit 250-260 average on the land as you drift left and keep your speed through the next "tunnel" with the wee jumps either side.

Just 2 places where I personally would 'Gasm' but Im boring myself now.....  Time to trudge half a mile to the nearest shop through 10 inches of snow, sometimes it isnt so good being so damn isolated 🙁

--Don't Struggle like That or i'll only Love You More--
